visual_enhancers.paper_texture: Subtle SVG noise overlay / grain effect with antique gold accent borders (1px solid #C5A059)
visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle parchment shadow, rounded-lg, 1px solid antique gold border (#C5A059), soft inset lighting
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or crisp rectangular buttons with gold border trim, smooth transition-colors and scale micro-interactions
visual_enhancers.maps: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap integration with antique sepia tint CSS filter, custom gold marker icons, and coordinate rescue pin animations
visual_enhancers.progress_bars: Handcrafted dual-color olive & gold fill with percentage indicator and smooth framer-motion width updates

layout_strategy.grid: Bento style grid on desktop (12 columns) and responsive stacked single column on mobile (mobile-first)
layout_strategy.header: Sticky glassmorphism navbar with backdrop-blur-md, parchment/navy tint, theme switcher dropdown, network toggle (Online/Offline status pill), and Rescue Pin trigger

core_features_and_components.name: Navbar & Theme/Network Bar
core_features_and_components.description: Sticky header with Expedition Guardian crest, theme switcher (Parisian Chic, Tactical Dark, Deep Jungle, Desert Sand), Online/Offline toggle, Rescue Pin trigger button, and User Auth modal button.

core_features_and_components.name: Global Destination Search & Gemini Briefing
core_features_and_components.description: Universal search box for any location worldwide. Calls backend API (powered by Gemini) to fetch detailed briefing (Weather, Terrain, Water Sources, Medical Hazards).

core_features_and_components.name: Automated Offline Language Vault Pack
core_features_and_components.description: Auto-detected primary language/dialect phrase pack for Emergency, Navigation, and Medical terms generated by Gemini with pronunciation guides and one-click copy/listen.

core_features_and_components.name: Leaflet OSM Map & Offline Vault Manager
core_features_and_components.description: Interactive map with route/checkpoint plotting, 'Save to Vault' button storing map refs, briefing, and phrase pack to localStorage, and Offline Last Known Coordinates Rescue Pin drop.

core_features_and_components.name: Interactive Readiness Score & Dynamic Checklists
core_features_and_components.description: Real-time readiness gauge with breakdown metrics (Navigation, Water, Communication, First Aid) and interactive checklist items that recalculate the readiness score live upon checking/unchecking.

core_features_and_components.name: Field Response & Emergency Menu
core_features_and_components.description: High-priority quick response emergency panel ('I'm Lost', 'Low on Water', 'Medical Problem', 'Lost Supplies') with instant coordinate capture and action step-by-step guidance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Playfair Display and Work Sans in index.html.
Implement theme switcher via state/CSS variables or Tailwind classes supporting all 4 themes (Parisian Chic, Tactical Dark, Deep Jungle, Desert Sand).
Ensure background defaults to #FBF9F5 in Parisian Chic mode with antique gold borders (#C5A059) and muted olive/navy accents.
Do NOT include any AI chatbox floating UI or conversational assistant. The Gemini backend must be used strictly for destination briefing generation and phrase pack synthesis.
Ensure Leaflet maps work seamlessly with standard OpenStreetMap tiles and custom antique map overlays or filters.
Save to Offline Vault should write to localStorage key 'expedition_guardian_vault' with offline fallback support when network toggle is set to Offline.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide-react icons exclusively for clean cartographic icon styling.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No generic AI slop aesthetic - embrace Parisian vintage cartography elegance with fine gold borders and rich parchment backgrounds.
Layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, glassmorphism overlays on navbars and floating panels.
Micro-animations for all hover/active states using framer-motion or subtle Tailwind transitions.
Every interactive button, input, tab, and card must carry a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
